name: Gasperlerhof
beschreibung: The Gasperlerhof is a traditional inn in the Milders district of Neustift im Stubaital. The building is characterized by its Alpine architecture and a quiet location on the valley floor. The dining room serves regional Tiroler cuisine with seasonal dishes. The guest rooms are furnished in typical country-house style and offer views of the surrounding mountain scenery. In summer, the inn serves as a starting point for hikes and mountain bike tours into the Stubaier Alpen. In winter, the ski areas of the Stubaier Gletschers as well as Schlick 2000 and the Elferbahnen are quickly reachable. The inn is family-run, which shapes the personal and quiet atmosphere of the house.
